newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Five feared dead in Western Samoa plane accident.
newsitem.headline: Five feared dead in Western Samoa plane accident.

text.p: The national airline of Western Samoa said on Wednesday that five people were feared killed in a "serious accident" to one of its planes.
Polynesian Airlines said in a statement that the accident had occurred near Moamoa, south of the Western Samoan capital of Apia. The plane was flying to Apia from Pago Pago in American Samoa.

"At the present time the police department are making urgent investigations, but the airline believes that there may have been no survivors. There were three passengers on board the aircraft and two flight crew members," the airline said.
"The cause of the accident is not known at the present time."
It did not say what type of plane was involved, and officials were not immediately available for further comment.
